props.text: Click an Inspection Item (or a point above) to highlight where it is measured on the line.

out = []
	rows = value or []
	mx = max([r['pct'] for r in rows] or [1])
	for r in rows:
		out.append({'name': r['name'], 'value': r['pct'], 'max': 100, 'text': '%s%%' % r['pct']})
	return out

out = []

	return out
